messages:
Anya: Heads up — BrightBank (customer) is hitting tail latency spikes on embeddings after yesterday's model swap. CS flagged P1, asking for ETA on a workaround.
Miguel: Looking now. Can you paste the customer logs or the ticket link?
Priya: Ticket #C-8921 — logs show short spikes during long-context runs, CPU saturation observed on shard-6 rather than OOM. No exceptions in model logs. Customer wants a canary rollback timeline.
Samir: Oncall here. I saw queue growth around 09:20 UTC, autoscaler lagged. Likely warmup + large model footprint causing slow scale-up.
Miguel: If autoscaler missed the burst, short-term fix is to route BrightBank to raven-7b-std (smaller variant). That reduces memory pressure and should cut p95.
Anya: Can platform own the rollback? Customer expects action within ~3 hours.
Miguel: I can run it, but need deploy approval from Lina and a monitor from Samir. Priya will handle customer comms.
Lina: I can approve an immediate tenant-scoped canary rollback to raven-7b-std. Suggest 10% traffic for 10m verification.
Samir: I'll reserve a watch slot and bump pool min replicas if needed. Abort criteria: queue not dropping in 15m or error rate increases.
Priya: I'll tell the customer: tentative canary rollback + 30m verification, please avoid heavy long-context batches during that time.
Miguel: Plan: 1) create canary route mapping BrightBank -> raven-7b-std 2) set traffic=10% 3) monitor p95 token latency, queue length, and error rate. Command to run:
```
redwoodctl routes update --tenant brightbank --model raven-7b-std --traffic 0.1
```
Anya: Who's the execution owner?
Miguel: I'll execute. Samir monitors infra. Lina approves. Priya owns comms.
Samir: Also going to temporarily bump autoscaler min replicas +1 for pool-3 to avoid a thundering herd on rollback.
Lina: Approving now — Miguel, proceed when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Miguel — canary rollout: 10% -> raven-7b-std for tenant brightbank
Miguel: Canaries applied. Metrics link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123 (shortlink)
Samir: p95 dropped from ~720ms to ~210ms within ~8m; queue length normalized. Keeping watch for 20 more minutes.
Priya: Customer on call confirmed perf improvement and will hold for 30m. They want a postmortem and timeline for a durable fix.
Anya: Next steps & ownership: Miguel -> follow up with model/operator team about warmup behavior; Samir -> propose autoscaler config changes; Priya -> draft customer postmortem and status update.
Miguel: I'll open engineering tickets: ENG-3456 (model warmup + KV cache priming) and ENG-3457 (automatic route fallback + safe-rollback). Tentative ETAs: 2w for robust warmup, 1w for safe fallback automation.
Anya: Thanks all. If it regresses, ping #eng-platform and escalate. I'll close this thread in 30m unless we see issues.
